Chinese and all other "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"locales use English."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## ✨ Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Conversation-header archive button** — move the current session into the recycle bin from the he"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ader (no confirmation; always recoverable).
- **No duplicate of DSH's own affordance** — archiving f"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"rom the sidebar uses DSH's built-in hover button; this plugin no longer injects a second, differentl"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"y worded icon (0.4.4 removed the old row trash icon and the document-wide MutationObserver that drov"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"e it).
- **Recycle-bin manager** (Settings → 🗑 会话回收站) — archived sessions with multi-select: batch r"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"estore, batch permanent delete; each item shows its ID and path.
- **True permanent delete** — physi"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"cally removes the session log from disk and the projection-cache record; ghost sessions (records wit"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"hout a log) are cleaned up so they vanish instead of lingering.
- **Live-session protection** — sess"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"ions with an active agent are refused deletion.
- **Sub-session aware** — each row can show how many"},{"id":"p8s10","text":" sub-agent sessions it left behind (whole tree, any depth) and open them inline: title, size, time a"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"nd running state, with a checkbox per sub-session. Permanent delete removes the whole tree; the ones"},{"id":"p8s12","text":" you uncheck are kept and stay reachable as a "deleted main session · N sub-sessions kept" row inste"},{"id":"p8s13","text":"ad of becoming invisible leftovers.
- **Running sub-agents block the row** — a session is refused wh"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"ile any sub-session in its tree is still running, and the refusal names it.
- **Batch fault toleranc"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"e** — batch operations delete per-session with error collection and reporting.
- **Light/dark adapti"},{"id":"p8s16","text":"ve UI** — all colors are CSS custom properties in `client.css`; components follow the resolved DSH a"},{"id":"p8s17","text":"ppearance (`data-ds-dark-theme`) with `prefers-color-scheme` as the OS-level fallback (no hardcoded "},{"id":"p8s18","text":"palette). UI and code text follow the app font too (`--dsw-font-family` / `--ds-font-family-code`), "},{"id":"p8s19","text":"so the Settings → 字体 choice applies here as well."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## 📋 Requirements"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer** (this release is tested on that version only; older hosts are untested"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"**DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer** (this release is tested on that version only; older hosts are untested)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The recycle-bin list no longer reads session logs: its titles and turn counts come from the Session "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"projection cache (`SessionProjectionCache.cachedSnapshot`, plus `cachedPredecessorTitle` for checkpo"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ints written by an older format generation) — the same zero-I/O face DSH's own session list uses. On"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" a host without those two methods the plugin still mounts, archives and restores, but the list degra"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"des to 「未命名会话」 with no turn counts."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The floor is declared as `dsh.engines.dsh`. Note that DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 does **not** read that field: i"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"t is documentation for users and marketplaces, not a runtime gate."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## 📦 Install"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### One-click from the plugin market (dsh-market)"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Once listed in the awesome-dsh-plugin registry: open **Settings → Plugin Market** → search **dsh-ses"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"sion-recycle-bin** → install."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Manual"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Then restart the web app (stop the `dsh web` process and run `dsh web` again)."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Local development install"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Uninstall"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## 🚀 Usage"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"1. **Move to the recycle bin** — click the 「移入回收站」 icon in the conversation header: the session is a"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"rchived and an undo toast appears. Whether an archived session keeps showing in the left sidebar is "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"decided by DSH's own **View options → Filter sessions** setting (Hide archived / All conversations /"},{"id":"p24s4","text":" Archived only); this plugin does not touch it, exactly like DSH's built-in archive button.
2. **Set"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"tings recycle bin** — open **Settings ⚙️ → 🗑 会话回收站**:
- Checkbox multi-select → **Restore** (batch u"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"narchive) or **Permanent delete** (batch purge).
- Each entry shows the session name, ID and working"},{"id":"p24s7","text":" path (hover for full details).
3. **Permanent delete** physically removes the log and projection ca"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"che; live sessions are protected.

Every entry follows:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- Version section `## [version] - YYYY-MM-DD`, with only the `### Added` / `### Changed` / `### Fixe"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"d` / `### Performance` / `### Removed` headings it actually uses.
- One topic per bullet: **a short "},{"id":"p31s3","text":"bold lead stating the outcome**, then 1-2 sentences on what changed and why it matters.
- No impleme"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"ntation detail, no code, no test or verification results — those belong in the commit or the PR.
- W"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"rite only user-visible or breaking changes; skip internal refactors with no visible effect."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## 🔌 How it works"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- A **single npm bundle** covers both halves, same as other published plugins: the host row mounts v"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"ia `cordis.patch.yml`; the browser half joins automatically through `dsh.client` + `exports["./clien"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"t"]`.
- The browser talks to the host over the plugin's own `/api/session-trash/*` HTTP routes (regi"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"stered on the webserver; non-GET requests carry an `x-dsh-plugin` CSRF header)."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## 📄 License"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
